description: This line plot illustrates the accuracy (ACC %) of five different methods—Base, MEND, FT, MEMIT, IKE, and ROME—as a function of the co-occurrence number, which is plotted on a logarithmic scale ranging from 10⁰ to 10³. The y-axis represents accuracy in percentage points, ranging from 60% to 80%, with tick marks at regular intervals of 5%. The “Base” method is shown as a solid black line with circular markers, starting at approximately 64% accuracy and increasing to about 70% at 10³. The “MEND” method is depicted as a brown dashed line with diamond markers, beginning near 70% and rising to approximately 80% at 10³. The “FT” method is represented by a blue dashed line with triangle markers, starting at around 65% and ending near 73%. The “MEMIT” method is shown as a purple dashed line with circular markers, beginning at roughly 68% and increasing to about 77%. The “IKE” method is indicated by a red dashed line with triangle markers, starting near 66% and rising to approximately 75%. The “ROME” method is shown as a green dashed line with square markers, starting at about 74% and increasing to nearly 83% at 10³. All lines show a general upward trend as the co-occurrence number increases.
